messages:
anya: Quick sync notes from today's design review for credential flows. Focus areas: bulk rotate UX, preset scopes, mobile actions, and undo semantics. Posting the short log here.

ben: bulk rotate table looks scary. We show a per-row checkbox + a bulk toolbar; when 50+ rows selected the toolbar height pushes content. Can we make it sticky and compress to an icon row?

lisa: yes, sticky condensed toolbar makes sense. Also the bulk rotate modal is wordy. Users want a single clear step: create new tokens -> update clients -> rotate. Maybe split into two phases: Generate new tokens (with download step) then rotate.

priya: for the generate step, we should support 'preset scopes' to reduce mistakes (e.g., read-only analytics, webhook-only). Microcopy for presets: 'Choose a preset to limit permissions. You can customize after creation.' Keep preset pills left of scope list.

anya: good — add an inline 'Why limit scopes?' tooltip linking help doc.

ben: mobile issue: bulk actions collapse into a floating action button currently. Users expect a bottom sheet listing actions. Proposed: bottom-sheet on mobile with primary action 'Generate replacements' and secondary 'Rotate selected'.

lisa: accessibility: bottom sheet must trap focus and have clear close button. Add role="dialog" aria-modal="true" and ensure escape closes.

priya: copy tweak for rotate confirmation: current copy says 'This will invalidate selected tokens.' Suggest: 'Rotating now will stop existing tokens immediately. Make sure replacement tokens are created and deployed before rotating.' Emphasize 'stop existing tokens immediately' in bold.

anya: undo behavior: product prefers an undo window (snackbar) that can reinstate tokens for 2 minutes. Ops cautions that immediate reinstatement could confuse audit logs. Suggest: implement soft-revoke (tokens marked inactive but still allowed for 2 minutes) then final revoke after grace window. Copy in snackbar: 'Tokens rotated. Undo (2 min)'.

ben: telemetry: emit event token_bulk_rotate_started, token_bulk_rotate_completed, token_undo_reinstated with list size, user_id, project_id. Helps support debug.

lisa: for the generation modal, we currently auto-open the secret drawer with full token visible. Suggest mask by default and add a visible 'Reveal token' control. Also provide 'Download .env' and 'Copy' buttons grouped.

priya: keyboard order: after generation, focus should go to the reveal button, then copy, then download, then done. If the user hits copy, we should flip primary style to Done.

anya: compact microcopy change: replace 'Created at' with 'Created' and 'Last used' with 'Used'. Saves column width.

ben: mobile rows: action icons overflow. Proposal: show only one icon (reveal) and collapse others into kebab. On desktop show text labels on hover.

lisa: revocation modal: show a short list of example impacts e.g., 'CLI deployments, webhooks, integrations' instead of generic 'clients'. Users reported confusion.

priya: test case: make sure screen readers announce the number of tokens selected when bulk toolbar appears: aria-live="polite" region with '3 tokens selected'.

devops-bot: Reminder: security review requested by @priya. Deadline: 4 days.

anya: I'll update Figma with condensed toolbar, generation modal mask, and mobile bottom sheet today. Planning 30-min pairing with Eng tomorrow 10:30 to validate focus order and undo lifecycle.

ben: thanks 44d — I'll stub telemetry events in the backend after the pairing.

lisa: leaving a little follow-up: add microcopy for preset caution: 'Preset limits can be removed later; rotating may be required if you expand scope.'

priya: noted. Closing notes: want a short a11y checklist in the PR template: focus order, aria-live for selection counts, role=dialog on modals, and visible skip links for long lists.

anya: perfect — will attach updated frames and copy in the PR.
